findings.title: ✅ All four selectable models are trained
findings.detail: Trained classifier heads are shipped in weights/ and loaded by cifar_models.load(). Accuracy as served on the 5,000-image benchmark test split: CNN 68.6%, ResNet50 84.1%, VGG16 80.4%, MobileNetV2 84.8%. (Previously 3 of 4 models had a random, untrained head and scored 10–16%.) The heads were re-trained with the benchmark protocol on the official CIFAR-10 binary release; the benchmark tables on this page were produced from JPEG copies of CIFAR-10, which explains why served transfer accuracy is a few points higher.

findings.title: ✅ Backbone-specific preprocessing
findings.detail: Images are up-sampled to 96 px and passed through each backbone's own preprocess_input() inside the graph — the same protocol the heads were trained with.

findings.title: ✅ Model information is read from the loaded model
findings.detail: The sidebar shows the true parameter count (CNN: 167,562) and architecture.

findings.title: ✅ Uploads are unlabelled by default
findings.detail: Uploaded images are no longer scored against the dropdown class; a true label can optionally be given and only labelled images enter session accuracy and the confusion matrix.

findings.title: ✅ Results persist across widget changes
findings.detail: The last prediction is kept in st.session_state, so moving the Top-k slider or switching tabs no longer clears it. A 100-image labelled test gallery replaces repeated scoring of 10 images.

findings.title: Remaining limitation: frozen backbones, no augmentation
findings.detail: Transfer models are frozen ImageNet backbones at 96 px; fine-tuning and augmentation would raise accuracy further. The CNN is a compact 2-conv network trained from scratch.
